auth.heroTitle: Clear student insight for teachers and school leadership.
auth.heroBody: Sign in to access protected dashboards prepared for future Canvas, report file, and student information warehouse data.
auth.error: Unable to sign in with those credentials.
dashboard.title: Student data workspace
dashboard.description: Live overview of students, behaviour, projects, and early-warning flags across the school.
syncHistory.title: Sync history
syncHistory.description: Automated data synchronisation runs that load the warehouse from Canvas LMS, report files, and school systems.
syncHistory.tableHint: Completed and scheduled data sync runs appear here.
imports.title: Data imports
imports.description: Add individual records with a validated form, or download standardized Excel templates for bulk preparation.
imports.templateHint: Download the approved template first. The entire file must pass validation before any rows are inserted.
imports.fileHint: The file is validated as one unit. If any row fails, no rows are inserted and no history entry is created.
imports.awaitingUploadBody: Download the template, fill it in, then import it here to run validation before any future warehouse insert.
imports.historyTeacherHint: Teachers can only see manual and Excel entries submitted by their own account.
imports.historyAllHint: Principals and admins can see manual and Excel entries submitted by everyone.
imports.historyLoadError: Unable to load import history. Please try again.
imports.historySaveError: The file was validated, but its history could not be saved. Please try again.
imports.modules.behaviours.title: Student behaviours
imports.modules.behaviours.description: Quick logs for incidents, positive behaviour, classroom notes, and student support signals.
imports.modules.projects.title: Student projects
imports.modules.projects.description: Manual project tracking for subject work, interdisciplinary projects, and teacher notes.
imports.checks.templateBody: The uploaded file must use the same columns, order, and names as the selected module template.
imports.checks.studentId: Student ID must exist in the mock student registry
imports.checks.studentIdBody: Rows are rejected if student_id is missing or not found in the current mock registry.
imports.checks.requiredBody: Core columns for each module must be populated before the file can be accepted.
imports.checks.dateBody: Date-like fields are checked against the standard warehouse-friendly date format.
imports.errors.templateMismatch: Template columns do not match the selected module. Download the template and try again.
imports.errors.invalidStudentId: Row {row}: student_id '{studentId}' is not in the mock registry.
imports.errors.noRows: The file has no data rows.
imports.errors.importFailed: No rows were imported. Correct every error and try again.
imports.manual.title: Manual entry
imports.manual.hint: Required selections come from the backend and are validated again when saved.
imports.manual.loading: Loading permitted students and form options...
imports.manual.loadError: Unable to load form options. Please try again.
imports.manual.studentHint: Only students visible to your account are available. The backend checks this student ID again before insertion.
imports.manual.subject: Subject
imports.manual.saveError: Unable to save this record. Check the fields and try again.
imports.excel.title: Excel import
imports.excel.hint: Download the template, complete it, then import the finished file here.
students.title: Students
students.loadError: Unable to load students. Please try again.
students.adminScopeHint: Browse every student profile and open a full 360° view of behaviours, projects, and family contacts.
students.teacherScopeHint: Browse your assigned students and open a full 360° view of behaviours, projects, and family contacts.
studentProfile.stats.recentBehavioursHin: Behaviour records in the last 30 days
studentProfile.stats.projectsHint: Active out of all recorded projects
studentProfile.trendHint: Recorded behaviours per month over the last 6 months
studentProfile.projectsHint: School projects and their current status
studentProfile.notFound: This student was not found or is not assigned to you.

workspace.title: Custom report builder
workspace.description: Build private or shared dashboard workspaces from approved metric variables and Card templates.
workspace.myWorkspacesHint: Create and manage dashboards owned by your account.
workspace.sharedWithMeHint: View workspaces that other users have shared with you.
workspace.emptyMineBody: Create a workspace to start building a custom dashboard from approved metric variables.
workspace.emptySharedBody: Reports shared with your account will appear here.
workspace.missingBody: This workspace may have been deleted or is not shared with your account.
workspace.emptyWorkspaces: Create a workspace to start building a custom dashboard.
workspace.sharedHint: Shared workspaces appear for selected users after API sync.
workspace.workspaceSheetHint: Edit workspace details and choose system users who can access it.
workspace.dropMetricsHint: Drop metrics here to configure this chart.
workspace.chartSheetHint: Choose a chart type and the approved metrics shown in this visual.
workspace.chartTypeHint.pie: Compares the latest value of each selected metric as proportional slices.
workspace.chartTypeHint.scatter: Select at least two metrics: the first becomes the X axis and the remaining metrics are plotted on Y.
workspace.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently remove the workspace and every chart inside it. This action cannot be undone.
workspace.emptyChartBody: Open the chart sheet to select approved metric variables.
workspace.dropMetricBody: Metrics are template-approved to keep custom reports safe.
workspace.syncHint: Workspaces are synced through the app API when available and saved locally as a fallback.
workspace.defaultReportDescription: Build a dashboard from approved student metrics and Card templates.
workspace.metrics.attendance-rate.label: Daily attendance rate
workspace.metrics.academic-risk.label: Students at academic risk
workspace.metrics.late-submissions.label: Late submissions (30 days)
workspace.drilldown.subtitle: Students from the warehouse
workspace.drilldown.chartHint: Tip: click a data point to drill down into the students behind it.
workspace.drilldown.dataNote: These metrics are placeholder aggregates. The list below shows real students from the warehouse, ranked by behaviour and project activity, so you can jump into any 360° profile. Per-metric attribution will follow once ETL populates warehouse metrics.
workspace.drilldown.loadError: Unable to load students. Please try again.
workspace.drilldown.empty: No students available for your account.
accounts.title: Account management
accounts.description: Create, edit, delete, and assign roles for school analytics users.
accounts.formHint: Admins can manage profile fields, roles, and optional password resets.
teacherAssignments.title: Teacher–student assignments
teacherAssignments.description: Assign each student to one responsible teacher. Select a teacher, move students between the available and assigned lists, then save your changes.
teacherAssignments.noAvailableStudents: No unassigned students match this search.
teacherAssignments.noAssignedStudents: No students are assigned to this teacher yet.
teacherAssignments.selectTeacherBody: Choose a teacher from the directory to manage their students.
teacherAssignments.loadError: Unable to load teacher and student assignments.
accounts.accountsListHint: Manage access for teachers, principals, and administrators.

atRisk.adminScopeHint: Temporary behaviour-based flags, with Grade 9 students escalated sooner. Canvas scores will replace these rules when connected.
atRisk.teacherScopeHint: Temporary behaviour-based flags for your assigned students. Canvas scores will replace these rules when connected.
atRisk.rulesNote: Temporary rule: concerning records flag Medium; Grade 9 reaches High at 2 records and other grades at 3.

atRisk.emptyBody: No current behaviour records meet the temporary flagging rule.

digest.title: Student progress digest

digest.footer: Confidential — for the family and school staff of the named student only.

cohorts.adminScopeHint: Compare behaviour, projects, and at-risk counts across grades and homerooms. Click a bar or row to open that cohort's students.
cohorts.teacherScopeHint: Compare your assigned students across grades and homerooms. Click a bar or row to open that cohort's students.

cohorts.chartHint: At-risk vs on-track students per cohort. Click a bar to drill into its students.

commendations.teacherScopeHint: Temporary recognition from positive behaviour records for your assigned students.
commendations.listHint: Positive behaviour records are shown while Canvas LMS scores are unavailable.
